author: Priyadarshani Shrestha
review_text: NOT RECOMMENDED FOR GOVT PAYMENTS! We chose to make the NOC payment through eSewa so that it would save us time; instead it did the opposite because the NOC didn't receive the payment until 2 days later. We asked customer support to refund the amount so that we could make the payment through the bank instead but they refused. At the NOC, there were so many others who had the same problem as me, even the NOC officials were fed up of eSewa's payment service. Payment through bank is much quicker.
